# Transaction observation boundaries

The native observer delegates the real core read, write and file-based adoption
functions. An optional I/O refusal is armed only after a real ZIP publication or
a held browser write reports durable success. The receipt lists every intercepted
symbol and binds the unchanged original archives. It also retains the real fit,
Session and project model. These observations do not measure OS pickers or browser
download permissions; those need the browser drivers. Required-removal and listing
failures execute the production browser-storage JavaScript in Chromium.
